scope: 2025 ICPC Hong Kong A F H I J K L
limitations: Independent small-case checks; no online submissions or maximum-scale timing. L verifies operations and topological invariants, relying on the official classification-theorem argument for sufficiency.

A.method: all 2x3 and 3x3 bipartite graphs plus 300 random graphs; every interval compared to independent augmenting matching

F.method: 800 cycle-with-chords and outside-vertex graphs, random relabeling and edge order, exact directed-cycle recovery

H.method: all binary strings of lengths 2..8 versus all deletion pairs and literal LCP

I.method: 360 DFS-order sets through six vertices versus enumeration of parent trees and all sibling orders

J.method: 350 job sets versus every permutation and exact deadlines/penalty

K.method: all ternary arrays of lengths 1..8 versus all rotations and literal prefix maxima

L.method: random explicit allowed cut/reversal/insertion/rotation operations preserve DSU invariants; sphere/projective-plane/torus examples; classification theorem itself is not a computational proof
